import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

EXP = Path('/Users/alexy/src/grust/docs/reviews/sail-stream-experiments-2026-09-30')
BUNDLE = Path('/private/tmp/physical-log03-v3-bundle')
OUT = EXP / 'logging03-physical-execution' / 'attempt02'
DIGEST = '566f1cdac252397003552fc72837eac2f9f1e7f7896590b549733fc6a78e9ee6'
ROOT = '/Users/alexy/src/sail-extensions-gates/stream-experiments-20260930'
REMOTE_BUNDLE = ROOT + '/physical-output-log03-35fba73999e241c2-v3-bundle'
REMOTE_OUTPUT = ROOT + '/physical-output-log03-35fba73999e241c2-v3-evidence'

def utc():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def sha(p):
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        return hashlib.file_digest(f, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def write(p, value):
    with p.open('x') as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write('\n')

assert sha(BUNDLE / 'request.json') == DIGEST
request = json.loads((BUNDLE / 'request.json').read_text())
assert set(p.name for p in BUNDLE.iterdir()) == set(request['files']) | {'request.json'}
for name, pin in request['files'].items():
    p = BUNDLE / name
    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
    assert p.stat().st_size == pin['bytes'] and sha(p) == pin['sha256']
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
record = dict(started_utc=utc(), request_sha256=DIGEST, remote_bundle=REMOTE_BUNDLE,
              remote_output=REMOTE_OUTPUT, commands=[], launched=False,
              driver_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
write(OUT / 'intent.json', record)

def run(label, args, timeout=120):
    item = dict(label=label, command=args, started_utc=utc())
    record['commands'].append(item)
    with (OUT / (label + '.stdout')).open('xb') as out, (OUT / (label + '.stderr')).open('xb') as err:
        p = subprocess.run(args, stdout=out, stderr=err, timeout=timeout)
    item.update(finished_utc=utc(), returncode=p.returncode)
    for suffix in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
        file = OUT / (label + '.' + suffix)
        item[suffix] = dict(path=file.name, bytes=file.stat().st_size, sha256=sha(file))
    p.check_returncode()
    return (OUT / (label + '.stdout')).read_text()

try:
    setup = 'import os; from pathlib import Path; b=Path(' + repr(REMOTE_BUNDLE) + '); o=Path(' + repr(REMOTE_OUTPUT) + '); assert not b.exists() and not o.exists(); b.mkdir(mode=0o755); b.chmod(0o755)'
    run('remote-new-directory', ['ssh', 'morrobay', '/usr/local/bin/python3 -I -B -c ' + shlex.quote(setup)])
    run('stage', ['scp', '-p', *[str(p) for p in sorted(BUNDLE.iterdir())], 'morrobay:' + REMOTE_BUNDLE + '/'])
    command = ['/usr/local/bin/python3', '-I', '-B', REMOTE_BUNDLE + '/supervise.py', '--request', REMOTE_BUNDLE + '/request.json', '--request-sha256', DIGEST, '--output', REMOTE_OUTPUT]
    dry = json.loads(run('dry', ['ssh', 'morrobay', shlex.join(command)]))
    assert dry['prepared_only'] is True
    write(OUT / 'dry.json', dry)
    launch = json.loads(run('launch', ['ssh', 'morrobay', shlex.join(command + ['--execute-after-closure'])]))
    assert launch['launched'] is True and launch['output'] == REMOTE_OUTPUT and type(launch['pid']) is int
    record.update(launched=True, launch=launch)
except BaseException as error:
    record['error'] = repr(error)
    raise
finally:
    record['finished_utc'] = utc()
    write(OUT / 'staging-launch.json', record)
print(json.dumps(dict(launched=record['launched'], launch=record.get('launch'), receipt=str(OUT / 'staging-launch.json'))))
